q.en: Choose the correct preposition: He got ___ the train at Guwahati.
q.as: শুদ্ধ অনুসৰ্গ বাছনি কৰা: He got ___ the train at Guwahati.

explanation.en: Get on means to board a vehicle.
explanation.as: Get on ৰ অৰ্থ বাহনত উঠা।

q.en: Choose the correct preposition: He was absent ___ the class.
q.as: শুদ্ধ অনুসৰ্গ বাছনি কৰা: He was absent ___ the class.

explanation.en: Absent from is the correct pair.
explanation.as: Absent from হৈছে শুদ্ধ যুগল।

q.en: Choose the correct preposition: She is ___ the age of ten.
q.as: শুদ্ধ অনুসৰ্গ বাছনি কৰা: She is ___ the age of ten.

explanation.en: At the age of is the fixed expression.
explanation.as: At the age of এটা নিৰ্দিষ্ট বাক্যাংশ।

q.en: Choose the correct preposition: He is ___ the corner of the room.
q.as: শুদ্ধ অনুসৰ্গ বাছনি কৰা: He is ___ the corner of the room.

explanation.en: In the corner is used for an inside corner.
explanation.as: In the corner ভিতৰৰ চুকৰ বাবে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct preposition: The book is ___ the table.
q.as: শুদ্ধ অনুসৰ্গ বাছনি কৰা: The book is ___ the table.

explanation.en: On is used when one thing rests on a surface.
explanation.as: On তেতিয়া ব্যৱহাৰ হয় যেতিয়া এটা বস্তুৱে এটা পৃষ্ঠত থাকে।
